notes.title: Double Kick Heroes Launch News
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33190580/0d6405daa2806137658a3299673160ab4bed0dda.gif[/img]

[b]🤘 The wait is almost over! 🤘[/b]

We wanted to let you know that Double Kick Heroes will be leaving Early Access on August 13th 😈

It’s time to jump out of the mosh-pit and into your Gundillac, Sheila, and take on the baddest of badasses and survive in this metal moshing and mayhemic post-apocalyptic nightmarish wasteland.

"[i]Man, it’s been a long journey but we’re pumped to be finally sharing Double Kick Heroes with you all[/i]" [b]David Elahee - Headbang Club[/b]. [i]"We hope that you love our game as much as we do and enjoy the kick-ass soundtrack we’ve put together to celebrate all things metal. We can’t wait for people to try out air controls for Nintendo Switch which is a heap load of metallic fun, but please drum responsibly"[/i].

As well as leaving Early Access, Double Kick Heroes will launch on Nintendo Switch on August 13th, followed by a simultaneous release on Game Pass for Xbox One and PC and the Xbox and Microsoft Store on August 28th!!!

https://youtu.be/rcynIN9i3cw

If you've not been following our road through Early Access, here are some features you can expect on August 13th: 

[list][*] A full story mode that’s accompanied by 50 kerranging songs, including the OST Volume 2 Update, by top artists such as Ultra Vomit, Volkorx, Gorod, Jinjer, Carpenter Brut and Gojira!
[*] Unique Rhythm shooter mashup with incredibly detailed pixel art
[*] 5 difficulty settings to test even the most metal of metal head’s skills
[*] Tons of accessibility options
[*] USB drum and guitar support on PC (and Xbox One)[/list]

In addition to this, we have some Nintendo Switch Joy Con Alternative Motion Control Methods prepared for launch including: 

[list][*] Air drumming - Joy Con used as drumsticks, keeping in rhythm of game
[*] Air beat - Can't drum? No Problem! Stomp to the beat with your Joy Con
[*] Want the all out motion controlled experience and really put that double kick pedal to the metal? Then it's time to use two sets of Joy Con, one in your socks and one in your hands and drum and stomp your way through the apocalypse![/list]

We can't wait for you to get your hands on Double Kick Heroes and want to thank everyone for joining us on this journey. 

Don't forget to [url=https://twitter.com/headbang_club]follow us on Twitter[/url] for more news and announcements in the build-up to launch.

It’s Gamescom week, Parasites, and this week’s update is the largest one to date. We’ve got a ton of stuff to get through including new content (did we mention Act 4 is now complete?), what’s happening at Gamescom, release date news and much more. Shall we begin?

[h1]Gamescom 2019[/h1]

We’re here! We made it to Gamescom and Saverio (the boss Parasite here at Troglobytes HQ) is on hand with this brand new build of HyperParasite. Everything above is ready and waiting.  We can’t wait to show press, influencers and visitors what we have been working on implementing. Come and visit us in Hall 10.1 in the Entertainment Area of the Spanish Pavilion. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33190580/014783816343cf2128cb3b252805485f32020bbb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Release Date Update + New Price[/h1]

Since we released HyperParasite on Steam Early Access, the game has received weekly updates including two complete brand new acts, developer and community gameplay streams, a shit ton of new characters, levels, mini-bosses, BIG bosses, gameplay mechanics and quality of life features. As we continue to add more and more to the game, we feel it’s now the right time to increase the price from $10.99 to $12.99. Boss Parasite Saverio released the following statement to the video game press earlier today; 

“With the implementation of Act 4, we feel it’s the right time to increase the price from $10.99 to $12.99, which we feel still offers incredible value for money. If you’re at Gamescom, we’d love to show you how far our game has come along in development since our initial Early Access release!”

In addition to the pricing update, we’re also announcing that our planned full, and final, release for HyperParasite will now be Q1 2020. This gives our team the time required to complete not just the Steam build, but the Xbox One, PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch build too. We’ll continue to keep you updated here via the Steam store page and [url=https://twitter.com/_Troglobytes_]here on Twitter[/url].

notes.title: Some news from HELL!
notes.content:
[h1]A Newsletter from hell![/h1]

[h1]Hey! [/h1]

It’s been a long time since our latest love letter… if you followed our social media, you may know why but let’s sum up the latest news!

[h1]Nintendo Switch![/h1]
We are so so so thrilled about that!

Double Kick Heroes is coming to the Nintendo Switch! We partnered with Nintendo to announce the game will come to this incredible console. We also revealed one of our future Hellgate’s host, the amazing GOJIRA. Controls are not finalized, we’ll make sure to test it a lot and display it in conventions so you can make your own minds.


[h1]Announcement video :[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w1D5tJU3CUo

[img] https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27976788/56b0470d6f130f459d3bf47b64d881bb8241fd11.png[/img]



[h1]Chapter 6 is coming![/h1]
We worked a lot on chapter 6, the bosses are done, the levels are ready, we are tinkering everything and polishing. The story is now complete and we are very eager to show it to you. 

Spoiler : PAIN, THERE WILL BE PAIN ( stay safe and take breaks though, we love y’all! )

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27976788/0a77e75e4e99580a60bb5bc722ea2eb9cfbb68fd.png[/img]


[h1]Hellgate pack 3[/h1]
We will soon announce all the guest in the next pack, stay tuned on the social media. Let’s just say it will feature some very cool METAL from other indie video games ! 



[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27976788/005f78d08c5745e614206bdbc86cbdf95569ef10.png[/img]


[h1]Surprises [/h1]
We added many surprises in the next update but a bit of spoiler never hurts :
[list][*][u]Double grenades are now possible[/u][/*][*][u]Many monsters now have better behaviours[/u][/*][*][u]Some songs received new solos and vocals[/u][/*][*][u]Some fixes & framerate optimizations everywhere[/u][/*][/list]


The next version is still TBA but expect an update in a few weeks, we are waiting for the final vocal masters to release it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27976788/47961e8c4dfbb895175dd998ed12bd4dce9ccaa1.png[/img]

[h1]Quality Of Life[/h1]
As you may know, our ingame editor and roguelike mode are still lagging behind, feature-wise... because we had to finish the core game. It took us MUCH MUCH more time than expected...well let’s say Elmobo was super generous and the new songs are long and dense. No regret.🤘 

In March when core content is finalised, we will distribute quality of life patches for these modes, no worries.

This means : 
[list][*]UI will be tinkered[/*][*]More monsters in the editor[/*][*]Better discoverability of third party songs[/*][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27976788/239bd6392b5c50dd3dea3912fca53f116f743346.png[/img]


[h1]Chapter 6 & Final release[/h1]


As you may have understood, the game will be fully released on PC after the Switch version for reasons you may guess ( otherwise don’t hesitate to come to discord, we’ll explain ).

It doesn’t mean you don’t get to try the latest chapters... In a few weeks we will open a very special Beta for you to try the full game. So no worry if you cannot wait, we got you covered with a cool solution :)

In the meantime the PC game will receive quality of life improvements and new hellgate packs.


[h1]New Guests[/h1]

Our guest list is now complete ! Here is a spoiler :

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27976788/f1478f7a875115cdc01b876f31f97ff38b931736.jpg[/img]

So… we have got additional content planned for months, we won’t let you down🤘


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27976788/a75a0093b1ddce355cee183a7bc02a54e78989a8.png[/img]

[h1]PAX East 2019[/h1]
We’ll be at PAX East with some mysterious friends ! We’ll present you our latest versions and hopefully we can meet you there and have fun there!


[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27976788/3926c9665823212666eb56b3873ab39e5283edee.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27976788/1c972d2b0b10771d77ca9a00ff9812fffcc505b6.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Final words[/h1]
Thank you so much for your support, this adventure is completely crazy and we owe it to you!

[u]ROCK ON![/u]

ps: join us on twitter and [url=http://discord.gg/doubleKickHeroes]discord.gg/double.kick.heroes[/url] for fresher news! bye!

notes.title: Announcing HELLGATE UPDATE + Early Access Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27976788/1547942806647a08004a32694001b4c7167e41f4.gif[/img]

Hello Headbangers! We’re revealing our next update the HELLGATE UPDATE. It may come at the end of May along with the slick prototype of the Infinite Mode. We’re also revealing our Roadmap in today’s post!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27976788/b4ee343ba8d73186ff8e54bf91b55a849ffaf2ac.png[/img]

[h1]Early Access Roadmap[/h1]

We’re super careful about announcing dates so please, please DON’T TAKE THIS FOR GRANTED. Game development is a rocky craft that always takes more time than planned. We truly believe in being open but it also means potential delays.

Here is the order of our NON GRANTED BUT WANTED updates:

[list]
[*]Hellgate Pack 1 + Alpha Infinite Mode
[*]Hellgate Pack 2 + Beta Infinite Mode
[*]Infinite mode v1.0 + Chapter 4 
[*]Hellgate Pack 3
[*]Chapter 5 
[*]Hellgate Pack 4
[*]Chapter 6 (and thus, 1.0 Release = out of early access)
[*](to be decided…)
[/list]

We’re also continuously improving the UI & UX because we still have feedback around that.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27976788/825c6062c13b532ad121dcfd73c95dfd512208dd.png[/img]

[h1]THE HELLGATE OPENS SOON[/h1]

Our first big update will be the opening of the HELLGATE! The first two bands to get introduced in the Hellgate are Hell In Town with Cold and The Fundamental Wisdom Of Chaos and their song The Scarecrow Paradox. It’s only the beginning because we are talking with even bigger bands to get them in the game!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27976788/039c0abc902a552893dd761d6e5138c528db8fad.png[/img]

The Hellgate is a much more complete and “safe” experience, a bit like you could enjoy in Guitar Hero! It’s a bit more expensive for us but it ensure that good bands with good levels are in the game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27976788/26b926624c86c3fd8e540f9b5d05e979e21a8560.png[/img]
[i](Work in Progress and not DEFINITIVE, please don’t take it as granted)[/i]

[h1]TO THE INFINITE AND BEYOND[/h1]

Blackmagic & Gyhyom are working on a new game mode that some of you may heard about. We're calling it "Infinite mode" right now, but is it metal enough?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27976788/aab0788936d89c934e578a9ae5bd972615aaaf8f.gif[/img]

We still have a lot of undecided options on this mode such as if we should make short version of music tracks to make this mode "faster". But the prototype is already being started so hopefully, we can show something within the next weeks or so.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27976788/5d4e214a6c1adeb18ae8c871afadfdee9c341ec5.png[/img]

To finish, I’d say this is a big push from the team who wants to diversify the game and make it even more appealing for different kind of. This is only the sprout of what could be a great tree (a gloomy death tree, obviously).

[i]Cheers,
Tavrox, CM.[/i]

notes.title: Laser T-Rex and New Beta Wave
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27976788/a4b4876752bfe192939aa245f6a4a2210148b08e.gif[/img]

[h1]Laser T-Rex and New Beta Wave[/h1]

Hello there! Long time no see. Double Kick Heroes is still making progress and we’re finishing the last pieces of Chapter 2. There’s also been work around server storage, analytics, editor mode, difficulties, new levels… Let’s get in some of those changes.

Before that, we’ll be sending out new beta keys so make sure you’re registered on:
http://doublekickheroes.rocks/

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27976788/67a830df663b4d318dcf210e46753fd0316545db.png[/img]

[h1]Finishing Chapter 2 of Story Mode[/h1]
The story mode is important for us, we want you to live a great adventure. To sum up, when we’re building a new chapter we need :

[list]
[*]New crazy zombies with their style and animations
[*]Fun, arcade crazy Boss
[*]Full narration intertwined with gameplay, biomes & punchy dialogues
[*]Complete level design for the 5 difficulties.[/list]

The only thing left for Chapter 2 is the boss, we’re striking the final touches on it and will soon push it

[h1]New ROCK & VIOLENCE Difficulty[/h1]

On the return trip for Gamescom, Elmobo told us that he wanted a difficulty between metal & extreme. Something that is really fun, hard, but not too harsh. Something that doesn’t always involve the Snare, which can get really overwhelming and frustrating. Adding a new difficulty is not a lot of work, but we have to be really careful about balance. A new difficulty implies a lot of responsibility, gameplay wise! 

We also added something for the low-skilled people who want a high-level of FUN! This was a feature asked from Gyhyom who has a hard time playing hardcore games (such as Dark Souls and Furi) but still want to enjoy their lore and fantastic backgrounds.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27976788/82cc5aebc55e06b69e634e8554dff5396e19141e.png[/img]

[h1]Stats, Leaderboards, Servers[/h1]

Blackmagic made some work around servers. Why DKH use servers? Here are a few use cases:
[list]
[*]Analytics, look at how people, why, for how long? It’ll help us improve the gameplay experience. Totally anonymous!
[*]Custom editor levels made by players will be hosted on servers. We need something reliable and strong to take all use cases into account.
[*]Leaderboards to compete with your cool friend who roasted you on Guitar Hero. Time for a revenge, bruh![/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27976788/bd685f33152e94cf5821e7ea1b0d1a8076b2c6a8.jpg[/img]

[h1]No publishers? Whatever, let’s go indie![/h1]

We’ve spent a fair amount of time speaking with publishers those last months. We’ve seen them during Pax South (January), Gamescom (August), Gamesco (October). It took us a lot of time to make and refine all those business contacts. Alas, the game is a bit niche and it’s scary for those companies. WHATEVER. Let’s go full indie and ROCK your PC!

We're really happy to announce we will be at Gamescom to showcase the beta of Double Kick Heroes. We know that the game development has been a bit slower than anticipated, but that's quite normal for a video game production. We still made a lot of improvements on the game on several plans and the first beta package is being highly polished right now.

[url=http://wp.headbang.club/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Gamescom-1.png][img]http://wp.headbang.club/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Gamescom-1.png[/img][/url]

The beta we'll be showing on the public side of Gamescom contains:
[list]

 	[*]Arcade mode - Jump in a level, shoot zombies, make highscores, headbang. REPEAT.[/*]
 	[*]Tutorial - To help new players understand the game, we worked a lot on this one! This is crucial for the first time experience.[/*]
 	[*]Editor Mode - Pick your own mp3 and create a level design ![/*]
[/list]
[url=http://wp.headbang.club/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/intro_plan08.png][img]http://wp.headbang.club/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/intro_plan08.png[/img][/url]

We also have some numbers to share about the content we've been adding to the game.
[list]
 	[*]30 different zombified monsters including the famous chicken zombie, the clown fucker, the crazy gutter punks.[/*]
 	[*]Around 15 levels with unique tracks that will seriously blow your mind. Pinky swear, if I lie I'll be Satan's bitch.[/*]
 	[*]Story mode will keep you headbanging and laughing for around 3 hours.[/*]
[/list]
WTF are you waiting? Plane your ticket and come to Gamescom to try Double Kick Heroes !
